title: Live NFL
description: Atlanta Falcons v Cincinnati Bengals (Kick-off 2.30pm). Coverage of the week nine match from Bernabeu in Madrid, as the NFL comes to Spain for the second year in a row. Last year's game at this stadium saw the Washington Commanders take on the Miami Dolphins in a thrilling game that saw the Dolphins win 16-13 in over-time. Today's meeting between the Falcons and the Bengals is the first time the sides have met since October 2022 when Cincinnati claimed an impressive 35-17 victory at home.
